name: cfindex
description: Populates a full text search collections with indexed data.

params.name: name
params.description: name of the variable generated by action "list" to return the query containing all indexes of a collection.

params.name: collection
params.description:
Specifies a collection name. If you are indexing an external collection external = "Yes",
	specify the collection name, including fully qualified path.

params.name: action
params.description:
Specifies the index action.

- **update**: adds or updates documents in the index
- **delete**: removes specific documents from the index
- **purge**: removes all documents from a collection
- **refresh**: clears the index and re-adds all documents

params.name: type
params.description:
Specifies the type of entity being indexed.

- **custom**: index data from a query (default)
- **query**: alias for custom
- **file**: index a single file
- **path**: index all files in a directory
- **url**: index a URL

params.name: title
key
params.description:
- Absolute path and filename, if type = "file"
- Absolute path, if type = "path"
- A query column name (typically, the primary key column
name), if type = "custom"
- A query column name, if type = any other value

This attribute is required for the actions listed, unless
you intend for its value to be an empty string.

params.name: body
params.description:
- ASCII text to index
- Query column name(s), if name is specified in query

You can specify columns in a delimited list. For example:

- emp_name, dept_name, location"

params.name: custom1
params.description:
A custom field you can use to store data during an indexing operation. Specify a query column
	name for type and a query name.

params.name: custom2
params.description:
A custom field you can use to store data during an indexing operation. Usage is the same as
	for custom1.

params.name: custom3
params.description:
A custom field you can use to store data during an indexing operation.
Usage is the same as for custom1.

params.name: custom4
params.description:
A custom field you can use to store data during an indexing operation.
Usage is the same as for custom1.

params.name: URLpath
params.description:
Specifies the URL path for files if type = "file" and type = "path". When the collection is
	searched with cfsearch, the pathname is automatically be prepended to filenames and returned as
	the url attribute.

params.name: extensions
params.description:
Specifies the comma-separated list of file extensions that Lucee uses to index files if
	type = "Path". Default is HTM, HTML, CFM, CFML, DBM, DBML.
	An entry of "*." returns files with no extension

params.name: query
params.description: Specifies the name of the query against which the collection is generated.

params.name: recurse
params.description:
Yes or No. Yes specifies, if type = "Path", that directories below the path specified in
	key are included in the indexing operation.

params.name: external
params.description: This attribute has been deprecated and is non-functional.

params.name: language
params.description: language used to index

params.name: category
params.description:
A string value that specifies one or more search categories
for which to index the data. You can define multiple
categories, separated by commas, for a single index.

params.name: categoryTree
params.description:
A string value that specifies a hierarchical category or
category tree for searching. It is a series of categories
separated by forward slashes ("/"). You can specify only
one category tree.

params.name: status
params.description:
The name of the structure into which Lucee
returns status information.

params.name: prefix
params.description: Specifies the location of files to index when the computer that contains the K2 Search Service is not the computer on which you installed Lucee, and when you index files with the type attribute set to path.

params.name: timeout
params.description: the timeout in seconds for a single request of type url

params.name: throwontimeout
params.description: Specifies how timeout conditions are handled. If the value is true, an exception is generated to provide notification of the timeout. If the value is No, execution continues. Default is no.
